mechanics.claim: The wall knocks aside (airborne) enemies hit by the perimeter, but deals only trivial (0) true damage that exists mainly to trigger on-hit/in-combat effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Dark Procession'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|true damage}} to enemies it knocks aside, which triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret and [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]], {{ri|Sudden Impact}} or applying {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.

mechanics.claim: The wall can only be attacked by enemy champion basic attacks and turrets, taking 1 damage per champion attack and being destroyed instantly by a turret attack.
mechanics.quote: The wall takes 1 [[damage]] per attack from champions and is destroyed instantly from turret attacks.

mechanics.claim: The wall grants sight inside the ring while it persists.
